claims.text: Tác phẩm có thật, tên: Mūlamadhyamakakārikā

sources.quote: The Fundamental Wisdom of the Middle Way (MMK) (Mūlamadhyamakakārikā). This is the most important of Nāgārjuna’s works
Nagarjuna wrote Fundamental Verses on the Middle Way (Mulamadhyamakakarika)
we can divide Nāgārjuna’s works into three main groups
the ascription of the works mentioned to Nāgārjuna is largely uncontest
